verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only manual, in-app ways to manage codes: scanning QR codes, swipe-to-edit the username or associated account, swipe-to-delete, and QR-based transfer. Nothing shows a documented API, CLI or other programmatic surface an agent could use to seed TOTP secrets or store credentials. Editing a rooted phone's sqlite database directly is a user-side workaround, and the GitHub OTP and PAM implementations are developer building blocks rather than a vault-write surface, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create and update vault entries — seeding new TOTP secrets, storing credentials — through documented programmatic surfaces
